data.one_liner: Parallel task executor using isolates or async, like thread pools
data.what_it_does: Executes async tasks concurrently across isolates or async, supporting shared data and error handling.
use_when: Want an isolate abstraction without manual Isolate code
strengths: Supports shared data to reduce message overhead
Improved error handling and task lifecycle
weaknesses: Requires ffi, may add binary size
Overhead of isolates for small tasks
